features.text: Two flat straps following the blade's section, round-ended aft
A block round the pin at the leading edge, bored for the pin
Four staggered through-bolts: hex heads one side, nylocks the other
1/2 in pin with a domed head on top
A keeper ring through the pin under the lower lug
Black bush lips where the gudgeon lugs bear
